verdict.rationale: Mastra is a self-hosted, open-source TypeScript framework for building agents/workflows — it does not itself collect or process end-user data for model training; any training-data policy would belong to the third-party LLM providers a developer chooses to call. This 'opt out of training on my data' consumer-privacy axis is a category mismatch for a dev framework/orchestration layer rather than a hosted AI product.
